Client summary
- 26-year-old female, strict vegan (no animals, fish, eggs, dairy).
- Recreational lifter (has some training history).
- Goal: muscle gain over 12 weeks.
- Nutrition target: 150 g protein/day from plant-only sources.
- Full gym available.

Overview of the plan
- Structure: 12 weeks divided into three 4-week phases (Hypertrophy foundation → Progressive overload → Peak volume + refinement).
- Frequency: 4 weight-training sessions per week (Upper/Lower split) + optional 1 active recovery or conditioning session.
- Progression: increase load or volume each week, deload at end of each 4-week block if needed.
- Rep ranges: primary hypertrophy range 6–15. Mix of compound heavy sets (6–8) and moderate sets (8–15) to drive size.
- Tempo: control eccentric (2–3 sec), 0–1 sec pause, explosive concentric unless specified.
- Rest: 60–120 s between hypertrophy sets; 2–3 min for heavy compound sets.
- Accessory work includes unilateral movements, posterior chain, and core.
- Recovery: sleep 7–9 hours, manage stress, foam rolling and mobility 10–15 min post-session.
- Nutrition: target calories slight surplus (+200–400 kcal above maintenance). Protein 150 g/day from plant sources, distribute 25–35 g protein per meal across 4–5 meals and include protein with snacks. Emphasize leucine-rich pulses/soy, complementing carbs and fats. Supplement suggestions: vegan protein powder (pea + rice blend or soy isolate), creatine monohydrate 5 g/day, B12 supplement, vitamin D if low, possibly omega-3 (algal DHA/EPA). Hydration: 2.5–3 L/day baseline.

Protein strategy (practical)
- Aim for 150 g/day. Example distribution across 4 meals + snacks:
  - Breakfast: 30 g (e.g., tofu scramble 150 g tofu ≈ 18–20 g + 2 tbsp peanut butter 8 g = 26–28 g; add scoop vegan protein 20 g if needed)
  - Lunch: 35 g (e.g., tempeh 150 g ≈ 30 g + quinoa/beans)
  - Post-workout shake: 25–30 g (1 scoop vegan protein 20–30 g + oat milk)
  - Dinner: 40 g (e.g., seitan 150–200 g ≈ 30–50 g + lentils/beans)
  - Snack(s): 10–20 g (edamame, hummus + pita, nuts lower protein but useful)
- High-protein plant foods: seitan (very protein dense), soy products (tofu, tempeh, edamame), textured vegetable protein (TVP), legumes (lentils, chickpeas, black beans), peas, protein-enriched pasta, quinoa, oats, nuts/seed but combine for higher protein, vegan protein powders (pea, soy, rice blends), nutritional yeast (adds protein + B vitamins).
- Leucine target per meal: aim for ~2.5–3 g leucine per main meal when possible (soy and whey higher in leucine; seitan and soy products best plant options).

Weekly training template (4 days)
- Day 1: Upper A (heavy compound focus)
- Day 2: Lower A (posterior chain + quad emphasis)
- Day 3: Rest or active recovery (light conditioning, mobility)
- Day 4: Upper B (volume & unilateral work)
- Day 5: Lower B (hypertrophy + single-leg focus)
- Days 6–7: Rest/optional conditioning or mobility; one session optional low-intensity cardio, mobility/yoga

Progression rules
- If you complete all sets/reps with good form, increase load 2.5–5% next session for that lift.
- If you miss target reps 2 sessions in a row, keep load same or reduce 2.5% and focus on form.
- Deload week recommendation: end of week 4 and week 8 reduce volume by ~40% or use lighter loads.

Phase 1 — Weeks 1–4: Foundation hypertrophy, form, conditioning
Goal: Re-establish technique, create training volume, accumulate work.

Week 1–4 structure (each week same layout, progress week to week)
Day 1 — Upper A (Strength + size)
- Barbell bench press (or dumbbell if preferred): 4 sets x 6–8 reps (2–3 min rest)
- Pendlay or bent-over row: 4 x 6–8 (2 min)
- Overhead press (barbell or dumbbell): 3 x 8–10 (90–120 s)
- Incline dumbbell fly or cable cross: 3 x 10–12 (60–90 s)
- Lat pulldown or pull-ups (assisted if needed): 3 x 8–10
- Face pulls: 3 x 12–15
- Optional: Biceps curl (ez or DB): 3 x 10–12

Day 2 — Lower A (Posterior bias)
- Romanian deadlift (barbell) or RDL variant: 4 x 6–8 (2–3 min)
- Back squat (high-bar or safety-bar): 4 x 6–8 (2–3 min)
- Bulgarian split squats: 3 x 8–10 per leg
- Hip thrusts (barbell): 3 x 8–10
- Hamstring curl (machine or Swiss ball): 3 x 10–12
- Calf raises (standing): 3 x 12–15
- Core: Plank 3 x 45–60 s

Day 4 — Upper B (Volume & unilateral)
- Incline barbell or dumbbell press: 4 x 8–10
- Single-arm dumbbell row: 3 x 10–12 per arm
- Seated dumbbell shoulder press: 3 x 10–12
- Chest-supported chest fly or pec deck: 3 x 12–15
- Cable horizontal row: 3 x 12–15
- Lateral raises supersetted with rear delt raises: 3 x 12–15 each
- Triceps pushdown: 3 x 12–15

Day 5 — Lower B (Quad bias, single-leg)

- Deadlift variation (trap bar conventional, lighter): 3 x 6–8
- Walking lunges: 3 x 10–12 steps per leg
- Leg press: 3 x 10–12
- Glute-ham raise or reverse hyper if available: 3 x 8–12
- Seated calf raises: 3 x 12–15
- Core: Hanging leg raises 3 x 8–12

Notes weeks 1–4:
- Choose starting loads you can control and complete target reps with moderate difficulty.
- Week 4: perform an RPE check; if feeling beat, drop volume ~30–40% (deload) or reduce loads.

Goal: Increase load on big lifts, slightly higher intensity, preserve reps.

- Increase emphasis on progressive loading: add sets for key lifts, lower reps for primary compounds (strength-hybrid).
- Keep accessory hypertrophy volume similar or slightly increased to boost overall stimulus.

Below is the full 12-week muscle-gain programme for your client (26, strict vegan, recreational lifter, full gym), with every adjustment rolled in: 4 weight sessions/week (Upper/Lower split), cardio plan, weekly cheat-evening (Day 6), vegan nutrition guidance (150 g protein/day), supplementation, recovery and intensified Phase 3. I’ve presented it phase-by-phase and then week-by-week so you can follow progression and monitor load. Swap movements as needed for equipment or injuries.

Summary structure
- Frequency: 4 resistance sessions/week (Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B) + Day 3 LISS + Day 6 optional active recovery + cheat-evening + Day 7 rest/mobility.
- Duration: ~60–90 minutes per resistance session (longer on heavy days).
- Progression: three phases: Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4) hypertrophy foundation; Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8) progressive overload; Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12) intensified (higher loads + advanced techniques). Deload/auto-regulate at weeks 4, 8 if needed; Week 12 is a taper.
- Cardio: Day 3 LISS weekly; Day 6 optional light or HIIT once/week (only if recovery allows); avoid cardio interfering with heavy lifts.
- Nutrition: target ~+200–400 kcal surplus above maintenance; protein 150 g/day from plant sources; carbs emphasized around sessions. Continue creatine 5 g/day, B12, vitamin D if needed, algal omega-3 optional.
- Cheat meal: one evening meal weekly (Day 6) with protein-rich item and moderate calorie allowance (+400–800 kcal that meal max).
- Monitoring: track RPE, sleep, resting HR, weekly training loads; adjust calories + recovery if progress stalls.

Protein strategy reminder
- Aim for ~25–40 g protein per main meal; use vegan protein powder (pea+rice or soy isolate recommended), tempeh, seitan, tofu, edamame, lentils, TVP, seitan. Include creatine in post-workout shake if using.

Phase 1 — Weeks 1–4: Foundation hypertrophy, technique, moderate loads
Goal: volume, technique, base conditioning. Keep intensity moderate and focus on controlled eccentrics.

Weekly template (all four weeks follow same session structure; increase load slightly each week if completing reps)
- Day 1 — Upper A (Strength + size)
  1. Barbell bench press: 4 x 6–8 (2–3 min rest)
  2. Pendlay or bent-over barbell row: 4 x 6–8 (2 min)
  3. Overhead press (barbell or DB): 3 x 8–10 (90–120 s)
  4. Incline DB fly or cable fly: 3 x 10–12 (60–90 s)
  5. Lat pulldown or assisted pull-ups: 3 x 8–10
  6. Face pulls: 3 x 12–15
  7. Biceps curl (EZ or DB): 3 x 10–12 (optional)

- Day 2 — Lower A (Posterior bias)
  1. Romanian deadlift: 4 x 6–8 (2–3 min)
  2. Back squat (high-bar or safety-bar): 4 x 6–8 (2–3 min)
  3. Bulgarian split squats: 3 x 8–10/leg
  4. Barbell hip thrust: 3 x 8–10
  5. Hamstring curl (machine/Swiss ball): 3 x 10–12
  6. Standing calf raises: 3 x 12–15
  7. Plank: 3 x 45–60 s

- Day 3 — Cardio + mobility
  - LISS 25–35 min (walking, incline treadmill, easy cycling) HR ~55–70% max. 10–15 min mobility/foam roll.

- Day 4 — Upper B (Volume & unilateral)
  1. Incline DB or barbell press: 4 x 8–10
  2. Single-arm DB row: 3 x 10–12/arm
  3. Seated DB shoulder press: 3 x 10–12
  4. Chest-supported machine or cable cross: 3 x 12–15
  5. Cable horizontal row: 3 x 12–15
  6. Lateral raises superset rear delt raises: 3 x 12–15 each
  7. Triceps pushdown: 3 x 12–15

- Day 5 — Lower B (Quad bias, single-leg)
  1. Front squat or goblet squat: 4 x 8–10
  2. Trap bar or conventional deadlift (light variant): 3 x 6–8
  3. Walking lunges: 3 x 10–12/leg
  4. Leg press: 3 x 10–12
  5. Glute-ham raise or reverse hyper: 3 x 8–12
  6. Seated calf raises: 3 x 12–15
  7. Hanging leg raises: 3 x 8–12

- Day 6 — Active recovery + cheat evening
  - Optional 15–20 min light cardio or mobility; cheat meal in the evening (see cheat meal guidance). Ensure at least some protein earlier in day (protein shake or snack) so daily protein target not missed.

- Day 7 — Rest / mobility
  - Focus on foam rolling, mobility, sleep.

Progression weeks 1–4
- Each week add small load (2.5–5%) or 1 rep per set if all sets completed with good form.
- Week 4: assess fatigue—if client feels beaten, reduce volume by ~30–40% (deload) or reduce loads.

Phase 2 — Weeks 5–8: Progressive overload & intensity
Goal: heavier primary lifts, add sets, maintain accessory hypertrophy.

Weekly template (same schedule days, higher loads)

  2. Barbell row: 4 x 6–8
  3. Weighted pull-ups or pulldown: 4 x 6–8
  4. Seated DB press: 3 x 8–10
  5. Incline DB fly: 3 x 10–12
  6. Face pulls: 4 x 12–15
  7. Biceps heavy/21s: 3 x 8–10

- Day 2 — Lower A
  1. Back squat: 5 x 5–6 (heavy)
  2. Romanian deadlift: 4 x 6–8 (heavier)
  3. Hip thrust: 4 x 8–10
  4. Bulgarian split squat: 3 x 8/leg (add weight)
  5. Hamstring curl: 4 x 10–12
  6. Standing calf raise: 4 x 10–15
  7. Pallof press: 3 x 10 each side

- Day 3 — Cardio + mobility
  - LISS 30–40 min; optionally include low-moderate incline intervals. Mobility 10–15 min.

- Day 4 — Upper B
  1. Incline bench: 4 x 6–8
  2. Chest-supported row: 4 x 8–10
  3. One-arm DB press superset one-arm row: 3 x 10 each
  4. Lateral raises: 4 x 12–15
  5. Rear delt machine: 3 x 12–15
  6. Weighted dips or triceps pushdown: 3 x 8–10
  7. Hammer curls: 3 x 10–12

- Day 5 — Lower B
  1. Trap bar deadlift: 4 x 5–6 (heavy)
  2. Front squat or paused front squat: 4 x 6–8
  3. Walking lunges (heavier): 3 x 10/leg
  4. Leg press: 4 x 10–12
  5. Single-leg glute bridge: 3 x 10/leg
  6. Seated calf raise: 4 x 12–15
  7. Weighted decline sit-ups: 3 x 10–12

- Day 6 — Active recovery + cheat evening
  - Light cardio 15–20 min or mobility. Cheat meal night (one larger vegan meal; include a protein-rich item).

- Day 7 — Rest

Progression weeks 5–8
- Increase main lift loads weekly if reps achieved. Add small volume increases on accessories if recovered.
- Week 8: monitor fatigue—consider auto-deload (reduce volume ~30%) if signs of CNS fatigue.

Phase 3 — Weeks 9–12: Intensified hypertrophy & strength (pushed intensity)
Goal: raise intensity with advanced techniques (clusters, rest-pause, heavy negatives, drop sets), lower reps on compounds, maintain accessory volume; Week 12 taper.

Key instructions before Phase 3
- Continue creatine 5 g/day and 150 g protein/day.
- Ensure warm-ups are thorough and spotters used on heavy bench/squat sets.
- Use advanced techniques sparingly: 1–2 per session max, and monitor recovery.

Weekly layout and week-by-week specifics

Week 9 — Build heavy baseline
- Day 1 — Upper A
  1. Bench press: 3–4 working sets up to heavy top set of 3–5 @ RPE 8–9 (total 4 sets). If 4 sets, first 3 are ramp sets.
  2. Barbell row: 4 x 5–6 heavy
  3. Weighted pull-ups/pulldown: 4 x 6
  4. Overhead press: 3 x 6–8 (last set rest-pause if needed)

  7. Biceps curl: 3 x 8–10 (last set drop set optional)

  1. Deadlift variant (trap/conventional): 3 heavy sets x 3–5 reps (RPE 8–9)
  2. Back squat: 4 x 5 heavy
  3. RDL: 3 x 6–8 slow eccentrics
  4. Barbell hip thrust: 4 x 6–8 heavy (last set light drop set)
  5. Bulgarian split squats: 3 x 8/leg
  6. Hamstring curl: 3 x 10–12 (eccentric emphasis)
  7. Calves & core

- Day 3 — LISS 30 min + mobility
- Day 4 — Upper B
  1. Incline bench: 4 x 6–8 heavy
  2. Chest-supported row: 4 x 8
  3. One-arm DB press: 3 x 8–10
  4. Lateral raises: 4 x 12–15 (last set rest-pause)
  5. Rear delt flies: 3 x 12–15
  6. Triceps heavy movement: 3 x 6–8
  7. Light finishers for back/shoulder health

- Day 5 — Lower B
  1. Front squat or pause squat: work to heavy top set 3–5 + 3 working sets
  2. Trap bar deadlift or heavy Romanian: 4 x 5–6
  3. Walking lunges: 3 x 10/leg heavy
  4. Leg press: 3 x 10 (2 s bottom pause)
  5. Glute-ham or reverse hyper: 3 x 8–10
  6. Calves and heavy core carries

- Day 6 — Active recovery + cheat evening (keep protein earlier in day)
- Day 7 — Rest

Week 10 — Heavy / cluster emphasis
- Day 1 — Upper A (cluster on bench)
  1. Bench press clusters: 5 clusters x 3 reps @ ~85–88% 1RM with 15–20 s rest between clusters; add 1–2 lighter ramp sets before clusters.
  2. Barbell row: 4 x 5–6 heavy
  3. Weighted pull-ups: 4 x 5–6
  4. Overhead press: 3 x 6 (last set rest-pause)
  5. Incline DB press: 3 x 8–10
  6. Face pulls: 3 x 15
  7. Biceps: 3 x 8–10

- Day 2 — Lower A (cluster on deadlift)
  1. Deadlift cluster: 6 x 2 reps @ ~88–90% 1RM with 20 s intracluster rest (build up with ramp sets).
  2. Back squat: 4 x 5 heavy
  3. RDL: 3 x 6–8 (3 s eccentrics)
  4. Hip thrust: 4 x 6–8 (light drop set last)
  5. Bulgarian split: 3 x 8/leg
  6. Hamstring curls & calves

- Day 3 — LISS 30–35 min + mobility (shorten if fatigue high)
- Day 4 — Upper B
  1. Incline bench: 4 x 6 heavy
  2. Chest-supported row: 4 x 6–8
  3. Seated DB press: 4 x 6–8 (use rest-pause last set)
  4. Superset lateral raises & rear delt flies: 4 x 12–15
  5. Triceps dips/heavy pushdowns: 3 x 6–8
  6. Biceps finishers

- Day 5 — Lower B
  1. Squat variation heavy: 4 x 4–6 (pause or front squat)
  2. Trap bar or heavy RDL: 4 x 5
  3. Walking lunges heavy: 3 x 10/leg
  4. Leg press high load: 3 x 10 (pause)
  5. Nordic/ghr: 3 x 6–8 heavy negatives
  6. Calves & core

- Day 6 — Active recovery + cheat evening
- Day 7 — Rest

Week 11 — High-intensity hypertrophy (rest-pause & drop sets)
- Day 1 — Upper A
  1. Bench press: 4 sets — top heavy set 3 reps @ RPE 8–9; ramped working sets. Last bench working set: rest-pause (AMRAP, 15–20 s rest, AMRAP).
  2. Barbell row: 4 x 6
  3. Weighted pull-ups: 4 x 6–8

- Day 3 — LISS 30 min + mobility
- Day 4 — Upper B
  1. Incline bench: 4 x 6–8
  2. Chest-supported row: 4 x 8–10 (last set rest-pause)
  3. Seated DB press: 4 x 8 (rest-pause)
  4. Lateral raises & rear delt superset: 4 x 12–15 (last set rest-pause)
  5. Triceps heavy: 3 x 8–10 with a drop set on last set
  6. Light high-rep back finisher

- Day 5 — Lower B
  1. Squat variation: 4 x 6 (heavy)
  2. Trap bar or heavy RDL: 4 x 5–6
  3. Walking lunges or weighted step-ups: 4 x 10/leg
  4. Leg press: 3 x 12 (last set drop set)
  5. Glute-ham raises: 3 x 8–10 negatives
  6. Calves: 4 x 15–20
  7. Core: heavy carries 3 x 40–60 m

- Day 6 — Active recovery + cheat evening
- Day 7 — Rest

Week 12 — Taper & peak (volume down, intensity maintained)
- Overall: reduce total sets by ~25–30% compared to Week 11; maintain heavy singles/doubles to preserve neuromuscular adaptation. Keep protein and creatine consistent.

- Day 1 — Upper A (reduced volume)
  1. Bench press: 2–3 working sets + 1 heavy double or single @ RPE 8–9 (no clusters/rest-pause)
  2. Barbell row: 3 x 5–6 moderate-heavy
  3. Weighted pull-ups: 3 x 5–6
  4. Overhead press: 2 x 6–8
  5. Face pulls: 2 x 15
  6. Biceps: 2 x 8–10

- Day 2 — Lower A
  1. Deadlift variant: 2–3 working sets of 3–4 (heavy single/double top)
  2. Back squat: 3 x 4–5 (moderate-heavy)
  3. Hip thrust: 3 x 6–8
  4. Hamstring curls: 2 x 10
  5. Calves & short core work

- Day 3 — LISS 20–25 min + mobility
- Day 4 — Upper B
  1. Incline bench: 3 x 5–6
  2. Chest-supported row: 3 x 6–8
  3. Seated DB press: 3 x 6–8
  4. Lateral raises: 2 x 12–15
  5. Triceps: 2 x 8–10

- Day 5 — Lower B
  1. Squat variation: 3 x 4–6
  2. Trap bar or RDL: 3 x 4–5
  3. Walking lunges: 3 x 8–10/leg

Cardio schedule (integrated)

Cheat meal policy (Day 6 evening)

Recovery and monitoring
- Sleep 7–9 hours nightly; foam rolling and mobility 10–15 min post-session or on rest days.

Example 1-day meal layout to meet 150 g/day (adjust portions to calorie target)
